name: Cinder
description: A single-file H5 password vault whose world model is a derived number. The health score is stored nowhere: it is a hundred, less eight for every weak password, six for every password used twice, three for anything older than a year and two for every account without a second factor. Strength is read off the string itself — length, character classes, and a list of words that no amount of leetspeak rescues, so Passw0rd! scores as badly as password. Because changing a password also resets its age, fixing one weak entry can be worth eleven points rather than eight, which is the sort of arithmetic the tasks here turn on. 5 screens, 8 entries, a counter-driven passphrase generator that is never random.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — the score, the four issue counts and every entry's problems serialise as text.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view with per-site strength and issues. For the verifier only.

world.strength: 0 to 4 from length and character classes; a recognisable common word caps it at 1
world.reuse: any password string that appears in two entries marks both of them
world.generator: a counter over three word lists; the same number of taps always gives the same passphrase
world.seeded: the vault starts at 26 out of 100 — 5 weak, 2 reused, 4 stale, 5 without a second factor
